summary_en: Tender offer price raised from ¥3,450 to ¥3,570 per share. Offer period extended to 2026-08-27 (total 75 business days). Change triggered by competing bid from BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. announced 2026-07-29 and sustained market trading above prior offer price.
title_en: Notice Regarding Changes to Offer Terms in the Public Tender Offer for Shares of Kakaku.com, Inc. (Securities Code: 2371) by Kamgras 1 K.K.
translation_en_brief:
Kamgras 1 K.K., the offeror in an ongoing tender offer for Kakaku.com, Inc. (TSE Prime Market, ticker 2371) initiated 2026-05-13, announced on 2026-08-13 an increase in the tender offer price from ¥3,450 to ¥3,570 per share, with concurrent extension of the offer period to 2026-08-27 (total 75 business days).

The price increase was triggered by a competing bid proposal from BCPE Blitz Cayman, L.P. announced 2026-07-29. Kamgras 1 noted that the target company's market price had sustained trading above the prior ¥3,450 offer level. Although Kamgras 1 maintains that the previous price already reflected intrinsic value with reasonable premium to the pre-announcement market close, the repeated competing proposals created prolonged uncertainty that risked eroding enterprise value and stakeholder confidence. The consortium determined that completing the transaction expeditiously with the increased price was necessary to facilitate value-accretive management initiatives.

An amended tender offer filing was submitted 2026-08-13 reflecting these condition changes.
